laptops.summary: Added the dark/light mode toggle (N = dark, L = light) on ruth/dark-mode in a separate worktree, pushed it, and it was merged into main by Yazan together with Ahmad's pause and high score and Yazan's sounds and chaser drone. The main session was used for pulling teammates' work, planning the dark-mode prompt and checking the merged game; no other feature of Ruth's was started.
laptops.notes: The first message in the main session (12:00:55 UTC) has no recorded reply and was re-sent a minute later, so no interval is recorded for it. One turn ended by interruption (a refused command) with no final reply; its end is the interruption. A background-task notification turn (about 12:33-12:34 UTC) was started by the system, not by a message from Ruth, and is not counted. Permission waits are only visible when the request was refused or was a question to the student, so approved permission prompts count as working. The session that wrote this report is excluded; no subagents were found.
